central_idea_and_construction: One deliberately drawn unfurling fern as a compact organic pictorial mark. A gently S-curved thick stem rises into a broad inward curl, with three generous asymmetrical paddle-shaped fronds on alternating sides. The lower left frond cups upward, the middle right frond reaches wide, the upper frond is smaller; this rhythm rather than extra botanical detail is the identity. All connected to a coherent central gesture, no spindly branches. Deeply open white gaps between fronds and a round open eye inside the top curl. Flat moss-green silhouette, soft blunt tips and calm asymmetry. Centered 55% width, 65% height. No leaf veins, pot, circle, medical cross, letter or text.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Top curl and three alternating broad fronds.
specific_risk: Botanical category familiarity is intentional; does not establish uniqueness.
